author.metaLine: 1872–1933 · Thirtieth president of the United States
author.bio: Calvin Coolidge was the thirtieth president of the United States. His brief 1927 announcement removed him from the following year's presidential contest.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The announcement came during Coolidge's Black Hills stay, with the next presidential election approaching. White House history ↗ explains that the unusual word choose left supporters wondering whether he might accept a nomination he would not actively seek.
